title: The Wrong Recipient
tagline: A payment request that looks right in the preview, and isn't.
briefing: Alice runs a small design studio. Yesterday she approved invoice INV-0042: 1.5 ether to Bob, the illustrator who drew her new logo.
This morning her payments service, a Web2 API, sent the wallet a payment request for that invoice. The amount is right, the memo is right, and the wallet preview shows a familiar-looking address.

Before anything is signed, find out whether this request really is the payment Alice approved, then choose how the wallet should validate requests like it and prove your choice with a replay on the local chain.
objectives: Inspect the mock payment request and the transaction it would produce
Check the chain evidence for every address involved
Choose a validation strategy and replay both requests on the local chain

trust_boundary.title: Where trust changes hands
trust_boundary.summary: The authorization is the only thing Alice approved. Everything the API sends is a claim to be checked against it, and once a transaction is mined it cannot be taken back.
trust_boundary.disclaimer: The payment request in this lab is an invented, simplified JSON message, loosely inspired by HTTP 402-style payment flows. It does not implement x402 or any other payment protocol, and nothing here touches a real network.

steps.note: Recorded intent: who, how much, which chain.
Sends a request. It can be wrong, stale or compromised.
The last moment a mismatch can be stopped.
Once mined, the transfer cannot be undone.

choices.label: Pay the request as received
choices.detail: The payments API is Alice's own provider, so its request is authoritative.

choices.label: Approve when the wallet preview matches
choices.detail: Compare the shortened address the wallet shows, plus the amount.

choices.label: Check the amount and the network
choices.detail: Pay if the amount and the chain id match the invoice.

choices.label: Validate every field against the authorization
choices.detail: Pay only if recipient, amount and chain id exactly equal what Alice authorized; refuse on any mismatch.

choices.label: Refuse every API payment request
choices.detail: Never pay requests from the API; settle invoices some other way.
